thought.text: The keycloak DB volume may have partial import state. Let me reset it cleanly:

reasoning_content: Wait — the main keycloak uses the old DB volume (kcdata), which already contains the master realm, and the import previously failed partway through (the startuphafen realm may have been partially imported). In the KC import with IGNORE_EXISTING strategy — if the realm already exists (partially), the re-import may fail. Also, the previous import was executed against the same kcdata volume, and master may have been created, and the startuphafen import failed midway through createUser. On re-import, "Full model import requested. Strategy: IGNORE_EXISTING" — if the realm already exists, it might result in an error like "Realm already exists". To be safe, let's also delete the kcdata volume: docker compose down + volume rm, then run up.

action.command:
cd /workspace && docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml down 2>&1 | tail -2
docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml up -d 2>&1 | tail -4
